title: I Took the Continuing-Ed Quiz Proctor Code to the Class They Marked Incomplete

parts.text: I finished the quiz at 8:41 p.m. under the proctor code on the projector. The portal marked me incomplete at 8:42. I was forty-eight, night student, holding a confirmation PDF. Instructor Vale said, "Codes expire when I get tired." I pointed at the syllabus: PORTAL TIME GOVERNS. I forwarded the PDF and the projector still to the dean of continuing ed. Vale reopened the quiz. My complete posted with the original 8:41. Vale keeps a bedtime that is not a policy. I keep the cert.

social.video_title: They marked me incomplete under a live proctor code — Part 1/1
social.description: 8:41 PDF, a tired code, and a syllabus about portal time. The dean reopened it. Has a bedtime ever graded you?
